rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to express a personal judgment or assessment.

example.english: I deem this restaurant pretty good.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢間餐廳幾好食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Choose this for a more deliberate or formal statement of what someone considers to be true.

example.english: After careful consideration, I deem this proposal feasible.
example.traditional: 經過詳細考慮後，我認為呢個方案係可行嘅。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 coeng4 sai3 haau2 leoi6 hau6 ngo5 jing6 wai4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 hai6 ho2 hang4 ge3

rows.note: Use this when explicitly regarding or treating A as being B.

example.english: We deem him one of our own.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dong1 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4
